summary: Propagate controlled-memory ceilings to MP4 parser metadata admission in remux and concat
before: A valid 40ms AVC file with 1MiB of moov/free padding was accepted by owned remux planning under a 64KiB controlled-memory ceiling. Direct parser metadata admission correctly refused at 64KiB; small input at 64KiB and padded input at 2MiB passed. Original suite: 2 controls passed, 1 acceptance failed.
after: Clamp parser metadata_bytes to the configured controlled ceiling in owned remux, native concat, native route inspection and MP4 planning/preflight. Preserve typed unsupported errors internally so recognized metadata/resource failures reach the owned route and keep their budget explanation; unknown sample entries retain refusal/fallback eligibility. Existing public interfaces remain compatible; route inspection adds an optional-memory helper.
results: Player: 7 focused + 12 related passed. Default: 6 focused + 6 related passed. All 0 failed, 0 ignored. Existing destination and temporary-output cleanup, unsupported entry control, native RGB, 40ms duration, repeated EOF, rewind and five seeks pass.
tests_run: cargo test --locked --offline --features player --test mp4_metadata_admission --test mp4_remux_prefix_budget_regression --test mp4_concat_selected_compatibility --test mp4_remux_plan_capacity
independence: This concerns raw input moov/fragment allocation admission before parsing, not retained output tags/chapters or generated MP4 output indexes covered by FVID-0326/FVID-0329. Route and file variants count together once.
limits: Parser metadata admission only: this does not prove physical RSS bounds or complete aggregate accounting of all parser/decoder allocations. No performance claim.

audio_follow_up.before: Geometry and decode plan admitted legal 2MiB moov padding under 1MiB controlled memory; small/ample controls passed (2 failed, 1 passed).
audio_follow_up.after: Carry metadata ceilings through MP4 audio export, scalar decoders, WAVE source metadata and option-aware native probes. Legacy unconfigured AAC probe keeps its interface and default ceiling. Root/library decode refuses before output; ample budget decodes exactly 136 mono frames at 8kHz with byte-identical format and PCM data to unpadded input.
audio_follow_up.results: Default 14 passed; player 15 passed; no failures or newly ignored tests. Initial test Debug-bound compile error was corrected with explicit match without altering refusal assertions.
audio_follow_up.counting: Additional route completion of FVID-0332 only
